tex/topological_theology_manuscript_lifted.tex:We did not begin with a theory of evil. We began with a failure of language. tex/topological_theology_manuscript_lifted.tex:The problem is not that Augustine, Dante, or Milton lacked insight. The problem is that the vocabulary they inherited --- substance, essence, sin, punishment, soul --- belongs to an ontology that cannot distinguish between a living system and a dead one in the structural sense. These are moral words. What evil, hell, Satan, and damnation require are geometric words: coordinates --- dimensionality, topology, symmetry, kinetics, criticality, chirality.
